Frederik Pohl and C. M. Kornbluth, Search the Sky.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/frederik-pohl_c-m-kornbluth/search-the-sky

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Frederik Pohl, author, died 2013 (Wikidata Q312641, P570 = 2013-09-02).
- C. M. Kornbluth, author, died 1958 (Wikidata Q376859, P570 = 1958-03-21).

First publication of the text used: 1954 (SE colophon: 'Search the Sky was published in 1954 by Frederik Pohl and C. M. Kornbluth.'; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Search_the_Sky says it was first published in 1954 by Ballantine Books and describes both authors as American).

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text is not from before 1931, so the United States term is not a fixed date here. Standard Ebooks states that the text is in the United States public domain (rights statement below), and for a text whose origin is the United States that statement covers the origin as well.
- Country of origin (United States): the text was first published there in 1954. The origin is the United States, so no other country's term applies.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
